description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - Order to issue a certificate of Exemption to the Tariff Consumers who participate in Community based Roof Top Solar Electricity generation from 03.01.2017 to 02.01.2037
reasoning: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory notice issued under the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009 (amended) by the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka. It concerns the issuance of a Certificate of Exemption from licensing requirements for electricity generation, which falls under regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements - the core definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5).
